In this work, we investigate the effects of fine-tuning on the reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs), focusing on three key questions: a) How does fine-tuning impact LLM performance when utilizing Chain-of-Thought reasoning? b) Does fine-tuning affect the faithfulness of CoT reasoning? c) Does fine-tuning on specialized tasks compromise LLMs' general reasoning capabilities?
